status.evidence: According to the company's official website, the Fleetsmart brand is owned and operated by Northern Technology Ltd (Company Number: 07411486), which lists its copyright date and active address at 3 Beecham Ct, Wigan.

claims.claim: The company reports that its cloud-based telematics system provides real-time vehicle tracking with 60-second GPS data updates across mobile and desktop platforms.

A reported customer outcome involving a fleet of 105 cars demonstrated that Fleetsmart Ltd's core system reporting suite and driver behavior alerts optimized road time, increased productivity, and reduced fuel consumption, generating cost savings of £11 per vehicle per week.

The company reports that its GPS/cellular devices support self-fit plug-and-play installation via the vehicle's onboard diagnostic port (OBD) taking a few minutes, as well as professional installation behind the dashboard taking 30 to 45 minutes.

The company reports standard hardware compatibility with 12–24V commercial vehicles, alongside optional integrations including HD dashboard cameras, remote immobilisation relays, and driver identification fobs.

The company reports that all driver journey information is stored on a secure database hosted within third-party data centres certified to ISO 27001 Security System and ISO 9001 Quality Management standards, as published on the official Fleetsmart website.
claims.corrected: The company reports that all driver journey information is stored on a secure database hosted within third-party data centres certified to ISO 90001 Quality Management and ISO 27001 Security System standards, as published on the official Fleetsmart website.

claims.claim: A public statement by Fleetsmart's Business Development Manager confirms a deployment with a Wigan-based courier company that initiated services with 30 vehicles, expanding toward a projected 100 vehicles within the year.

Northern Technology Limited, the parent entity trading as Fleetsmart, filed statutory accounts for the period ending 31 March 2025 showing that its total assets increased by 19.6% to reach £1.98 million and net assets grew by 26% to £1.52 million, according to corporate directory Endole Open.
Fleetsmart partners with Motohalo (Halo Telematics) to supply and install Thatcham-approved vehicle trackers for customers requiring insurance-compliant security systems.

The company maintains its corporate headquarters at 3 Beecham Court, Goose Green, Wigan, WN3 6PR, United Kingdom.

The company reports its customer service and phone support operations are active Monday through Friday from 9:00 am to 5:00 pm GMT, supplemented by an online live chat and weekend priority email support.
